events.text: Your toddler has a tantrum that tests your patience. One wrong move, and the day feels ruined; one good move, and everything resets.

choices.label: Stay calm and comfort them
choices.resultText: They calm down quickly. Your bond feels stronger, not weaker.

choices.label: Set firm boundaries and distract
choices.resultText: The tantrum fades. There is still friction, but you feel in control.

choices.label: Lose patience and rush them
choices.resultText: Afterwards, everyone feels tense. You regret it more than you want to admit.

events.text: You are not 'just the parent' today. Your toddler reaches for you first. It is small, but it hits deep.

choices.label: Play together and laugh
choices.resultText: Your home feels warmer. The memory becomes a little anchor for the next tough day.

choices.label: Show up but stay quiet
choices.resultText: You do not turn it into a big moment, but you still show love.

events.text: Homework time becomes a negotiation. Your child either wants help, or wants to prove they do not need it.

choices.label: Help with their toughest problem
choices.resultText: They learn faster because you make it feel safe to struggle.

choices.label: Give tips but let them try
choices.resultText: You respect their independence. They rise to the challenge.

choices.label: Take over completely
choices.resultText: The work finishes, but confidence drops. Next week will cost you more time.

events.text: A teacher sends a note: distracted, careless mistakes, and a reputation that might be forming early.

choices.label: Adjust routine and check in daily
choices.resultText: Small consistency beats big promises. The grades slowly follow.

choices.label: Punish quickly and hope fear works
choices.resultText: They comply for a week, then hide the problem instead.

choices.label: Talk gently and ask what is wrong
choices.resultText: You discover it was stress. Once named, it gets easier.

events.text: Your teenager pushes back. They want freedom now, but freedom without boundaries turns into mistakes fast.

choices.label: Listen first, then set clear rules
choices.resultText: You keep the peace and earn respect. They test you less next time.

choices.label: Punish harshly to prove you are serious
choices.resultText: They resent you. If something goes wrong later, they will hide it.

choices.label: Ignore it and hope they grow out of it
choices.resultText: The rebellion fades in the short term, but trust weakens in the long run.
